professional.title: Pitch Intel
professional.summary: Sales Intelligence Agent (Sales Pitch, Custom workflows)
bullets: Developed Planner Agent and specialized sub-agents.
Built drag-and-drop UI to design agent workflows and map inputs.
Supports generation of sales pitch in text, HTML file , PPT file, etc
professional.caseStudy: For new/renewal of customers, sales team needs to manually gather a lot of data and prepare pitch deck.Sales team wants to cut down this time by using AI to generate the pitch.
fullDetails: Developed Planner Agent and Multiple Sub-Agents (web search, current packages, pitch_generator, battlecards etc) which are integrated into a single workflow to generate a pitch.
Developed UI components for drag and drop of agents and their inputs to create a workflow.
Supports generation of sales pitch in text, HTML file , PPT file, etc based on user's choice.
Supports integration of any MCP server and its tools into current workflow.

bullets: Designed and developed MCP playground for testing MCP tools
Implemented feature to show events as tools get executed.
Built consistency module to run tests against SME's questions.

fullDetails: Designed and developed MCP playground for testing MCP tools and validate tool executions with multimodal against SME's questions.

professional.title: Chat AI MCP
professional.summary: Customer facing MCP server (structured & unstructured data)
bullets: Executes LLM-generated SPGCI PySDK code to retrieve data.
Built MCP tools matching Platts Chat AI in accuracy and reliability.
Developed feature to access and onboarding multiple datasets easily.
professional.caseStudy: Company wanted to provide MCP as a service to customers but we wanted same accuracy and reliability as Platts Chat AI. Also we didnt wanted repeated SME's evaluation on newer MCP Tools.
fullDetails: Developed 5 MCP tools (get_methods, get_method_details, execute, get_agentic_metadata, agentic_search) which help in retrival of structured and unstructured data.
Integrated aws agentcore code interpreter to execute LLM-generated code safely in isolated environment.
Developed feature to access and onboarding multiple datasets easily with URL params and env variables.

professional.title: RAPID MCP
professional.summary: Internal MCP server (structured data from Rapid API's)
bullets: MCP solution to transform 100's of Rapid API's into MCP tools.
Developed MCP search strategy to overcome LLM tools limitations.
Integrated search with reranking API to surface relevant APIs.
professional.caseStudy: Rapid microservices are created using Rapid Automation and deployed, In similar fashion company required framework that can convert 100's of Rapid API's into MCP tools without touching microservice code
fullDetails: Developed Rapid MCP solution with tools (instructions, search, get_unique_values, execute, untility_tools) to transform 100's of Rapid API's into executable and searchable api's without changing code at microservice level.
Developed MCP search architecture to overcome LLM tools limitations by searching across Rapid API's and reranking them based on relevance.
Integrated utility mcp tools to create csv file and markdown images based on data retrieved from mcp tools.

professional.title: Text2SQL AI Agent
professional.summary: Nautural Language to SQL (customer data analysis, Trends, Insights, etc)
bullets: Developed AI Agent to convert NL questions into SQL to retrieve data.
Integrated LangGraph nodes,edges architecture creating feedback loop.
Integrated data sampling, query sampling & SqAlchemy tools.
professional.caseStudy: Product team has dependency on data teams for customer data insights, trends, etc. So company wanted to leverage AI for retrieving data and analyzing trends from complex SQL queries.
fullDetails: Developed AI Agent to convert NL questions into SQL queries to retrieve info, insights and trends from customer data.
Using edges and nodes design , agent is able to automate SQL error correction loops.
Leveraged automatic data sampling ,query examples and column descriptions to improve query accuracy and consistency.

professional.title: Mnesia DB Viewer

bullets: Developed full stack web application to manage mnesia db data.
Implemented REST API's to update mnesia db rows and push back.
Implemented automatic restore and backup of mnesia db data.
professional.caseStudy: In Peak seasons due to bad assets or job data, the Erlang engine comes down due to corrupt mnesia db data. So company wanted to develop a web application to manage mnesia db data (restore, backup, etc)

Implemented scalable UI components and REST API's to update mnesia db rows and push back to db.
Implemented automatic restore and backup of mnesia db data using automation process.

professional.title: Global DET
bullets: Built Data Management Application to improve data accuracy by 7%
Developed REST APIs for customer platforms with data validation.
Created dynamic entity workflows using Jinja, WTForms, Airflow etc.
professional.caseStudy: Data provided by vendors are not always accurate and upto date. So the organization required a way to correct the data and improve data quality across all entities in a structured way.
fullDetails: Developed a Flask MVT application on top of flask manager library to make edits to the data in a structured way which improved data accuracy from 90% to 97%.
Built Rest api's that are directly integrated into customer facing platforms that required additional data checks and edits.

Developed and integrated a airflow DAG to extract edited data and upload to S3 to further process into prod redshift db.
